notes.title: Golden Light Pre-release update
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Today the main branch of the game was updated with a pre-release patch, but first let's talk about something.

What's happening right now with our neighboring Ukraine deeply affects us as a russia-based team, both in terms of mental condition and development operation. We're currently considering options to secure our well-being and continue express our artsy and bizarre vision on games, as well as bring comfort to our families, as our country progressively became a less friendly environment. In the meantime - our prayers go to the people of Ukraine.


What's new in the update:
[list]
[*]The Gut whispers are talking directly to you. The Gut has something to say now, it'll give advices, try to trick you or simply tell you more about what's coming at you. We believe it adds to the narrative of the game and makes the world a more complete picture without depriving you from building that picture in your head.
[*]More handcrafted rooms for various biomes.
[*]QoL: Now you can turn off headbobbing in the game's settings
[*]QoL: You can now see controls prompt about throwing or eating an item on your screen, in case you forget.
[*]The Eternal Field has directional signs now that will lead you to biome entrances. This should improve navigation in the field even further.
[*]In Love with Traps memento now additionally makes it so handtraps wait a bit more before attacking you.
[*]Many fixes that should make the game an overall more polished experience.
[/list]

Upcoming full release is a huge milestone that we're proud of achieving. It's been almost two years since we've started this journey and it was a hell of a ride. We would like to thank you for all the support you've given us, it means the world to us that such a crazy game we made was able to captivate (or haunt, hehe) you throughout the early access.

We believe that Golden Light is a unique game, and while we consider it a full, complete experience - there are many more possibilities and suggestions that we'd like to review and implement without making a sequel (although, never say never!). This is why we're planning for at least a few post-release content updates, with stuff suggested by our players and ideas we didn't have in our initial vision (including occasional fixes if something breaks again, you can count on us ;))

Thank you for reading this, meat, you're my true golden love

P.S. "a new challenger appears"

notes.title: Price increase, New Full Release Window and Next Major update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/2603bcc88add79a1c467b3c466b25206c76162ec.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

For some time we've been busy with our next update and if you aren't a part of our Discord server it very well may have seem a bit silent around Golden Light. To break the silence we got some important news to share.

[h2]Price increase[/h2]

As we've already stated a couple of times both in our update posts and Early Access message on our steam page: we have plans to increase the price of the game. The initial plan was to do that upon release, but after we took time to overview the progress of Golden Light development and an increased scope of the game with features that weren't planned in the very beginning, stuff like Online Co-op, Meat Royale game mode and future additions, we've decided to pull the lever. There's no particular date or time for that, but we expect it to happen very soon after this post goes up. While the price hasn't changed yet - be sure to grab Golden Light if you wanted to for the current price.

[h2]Partnership with a Publisher[/h2]

This may come as a surprise to some (even us, really), but soon we'll become a real indie dev with a Publisher on our side! Currently we're in process of signing up stuff and soon we'll be able to share more about this! This partnership will allow us to continue development of Golden Light comfortably and let us add even more meaty fun to the game, as well as to take more time to polish already existing content. 
Speaking on the matter of time, let's jump into next bulletpoint.

[h2]Full Release Window Change[/h2]

Our first plan was to come out of Early Access somewhere in the end of Q3/start of Q4 2021, and now, when we know that we won't die from hunger in the coming months - we've decided to shift full release window to Q1 2022. This way we'll have more time on our hands to add more stuff and polish the game, and for you it means that you'll get even more meaty goodness from Golden Light! With a new release window we won't stop pushing one major update once in two-three months and also can plan for new stuff after full release.

[h2]Next Major Update[/h2]

The next major update is planned to release in a month, although you can experience some parts of it right now on the development branch of the game (alongside with bugs and instabilities that tend to happen on development branches C:<). Here's what you can look forward to:

[list]
[*]Online Co-op story bits and ending
[*]New system that lets mimics, monsters and friendly folks to pick up items. Sometimes you'll have to steal it from them!
[*]Cages biome visual overhaul to make it more unique, alongside a new enemy
[*]Pets improvements and an NPC that lets you heal them
[*]New boss weapons
[*]New mementos
[*]An even more clear visual navigation in the field
[*]Lots and lots of bugfixing/co-op stability imrpovements/optimization
[*]and more...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/6903a2bc95b1ef407d91461ca7f6524fc523e696.png[/img]
[/list]

If you got any questions - be sure to ask em here on steam discussion board, or in our discord server if you want to get in contact with us even faster. https://discord.gg/f9YTrJjS7J

notes.title: MEAT ROYALE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]The Gut has spoken and it wants MEAT.[/h2]

Specifically yours and of your meat bros that is! After lots of blood and sweat, trial and error we're finally glad to present to you: MEAT ROYALE - a 10 player battle royale-like deathmatch mode for you and your friends. (As well as 7 days of 25% discount starting today!)

[previewyoutube=LdMQabDhZes;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new:

[list]
[*][b]MEAT ROYALE[/b]: This is a new gamemode that you can access from Multiplayer button in the main menu. Simply press Find lobby or Create one and wait for someone/your friends to join, then interact with a door if you feel like starting the match. (Only host can start the match).

In this mode you'll spawn in a random point of a random level and have to find your equipment to slay the meatbros and take their keys to open the elevator and retrieve the Meat Crown. With time the level floor will start to burn leading you closer and closer to an exit elevator.

Our meat royale is a bit more fair to you, so if you die quickly - don't be afraid, you'll respawn in short amount of time somewhere where fire haven't spread yet. Use your second (or third, hehe) chance to outsmart your foes and take the crown. 

More work on this mode will be done, thanks to your feedback and suggestions. (and bugfixing).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/576e89007563f4e3ffb6252e5b973031519e780d.png[/img]

[*][b]Co-op player expansion[/b]: Maximum amount of players for Co-op is expanded to 10, try it out with your pals. (At your own risk C:<)

[*][b]MEAT MARKET[/b]: Of course it's not a battle royale without cosmetics, isn't it. In our own fashion we've added a Meat Market that you can access to buy different "head props/hats/cosmetics" with Meat Crowns for your meat bro. Make sure to pick the right one, as these props will be the only thing other players see when you crouch. Camouflage yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/72ef3856bf91c168521a478a1e42a60881383807.png[/img]

[*][b]New NPC[/b]: New players may find it really difficult to get into Golden Light, this is why we've worked with our community to create a sorta "Hint NPC". Find MEATPHONE in the field and talk to him for useful information, he's a nasty bastard but he's always glad to help you out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/b2c4fd69b4d821b84f229fc5092839a1dd366c40.png[/img]
[*][b]The Reds Renovation[/b]: We've started to update our visuals for The Reds biome a bit and you can notice that in this update. It just missed some artsy vibes! Big thanks to our community that worked with us on some of the elements, hope you'll like what we've come up with (and will come up with in the nearest future). If you want to be in touch with our development and possibly participate in any future contests - be sure to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/mm47XfrS5v

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/7ddc95dd1018358d369734aea6a2c94140ab133a.png[/img]

[*][b]Ambient Occlusion[/b]: Ah-ha! It's there and it makes the game look a bit fancier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/4edaf59689bd8d3de73eb206e4dc97e649a21fcb.png[/img]

notes.title: CHOOSE YOUR END Update: Endings, New Biome, New Mechanics and more
notes.content:
[h3]The Gut walls have shifted and you see a light at the end of a hallway that calls to you. Is it a sign of salvation or another fall to the depths of flowers of blood? Find out in our newest update "Choose Your End"![/h3]

[previewyoutube=UYQoU7R96OI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]What's new:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Endings:[/b] The game finally features an ending in a traditional sense, and not 1 but 4 depending on your playstyle: Normal Ending, Pacifist Ending, Genocide Ending and a Secret one. Alongside with achievements for Meat War and Meat Zone difficulties.

[*][b]New Biome - The Insides:[/b] True nature of the Gut is present in this one. Navigate through narrow fleshy hallways filled with dangerous meat and use skills you've learned on the way to meet your goal. (Of course it features a new enemy and Boss of the area).

[*][b]New Boss Weapon:[/b] Gut Divers will drop something fitting to their self. Use it wisely, you don't want to set the whole Gut on fire.

[*][b]New Mechanic - Golden Ember:[/b] Now on each boss floor you can find a "Golden Amber", a syringe with golden liquid that lets you lock one of the mementos you got which won't drop from your inventory upon death. (Mind that Golden Ember is abscent on Meat Zone difficulty)

[*][b]Reassembled Difficulties:[/b] The game once again features 3 difficulties.
[olist]
[*] [b]Meat Garden:[/b] An appropriate difficulty for newcomers and those who simply want to get through the game and experience it without wasting too much time. Achievements are disabled in this one.
[*] [b]Meat War:[/b] "Normal Difficulty", previous Sticky Meat.
[*] [b]Meat Zone:[/b] Originally intended horror roguelike experience with permadeath, narrowed vision (flashlight lighting instead of radial player light), stronger enemies.
[/olist]

[*][b]New mechanic:[/b] Thrown notes and weapons (which yes, you can now throw) will make a sound on impact and alert nearby enemies.

[*][b]New Mementos:[/b] Deadly Throw and Furious Reader. First one lets you deal damage with thrown notes and weapons, second makes it so you get random effects for each and every note you read (also this one powers up notes in various ways).

[*][b]Locked Doors are working as intended?[/b] Now if you break the door's handle it won't be locked anymore, no need to destroy the whole thing!

[*][b]I don't want to hear my heartbeat![/b] You can now disable your heartbeat and breathing noises in the settings.

[*][b]Our friends are alive as ever:[/b] Glutton, Lloyd, Crown and Juke should fight back now. (Or run away hehe)

[*][b]French Language is added:[/b] WIP, but it works! (As well as some fixes for other languages).

[*][b]Lottafixes:[/b] A lot of minor and not so minor bugfixes. (Multiplayer should be more stable, She's bodyparts won't longer fly out of the elevator, some gamebreaking different languages bugfixes, etc) 

[*][b]SOUNDTRACK:[/b] We finally released the soundtrack so be sure to check it out!
[/list]

notes.title: Online Co-op mode, breakable walls and more! Bound by Meat update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]HAPPY WINTER SALE MEATBROS!!![/h1]

[previewyoutube=uS5HE6CnsHA;full][/previewyoutube]

The newest update with 2 Player online co-op, breakable walls and more other stuff is LIVE on public branch, as well as a 25% discount for Steam Winter Sale (in an hour?). Ahhh, the perfect time to grab the meatiest game for you and your friend and finally try it out! If it's your first time - consume the Golden Light, let it's weirdness fill you. If it's not - you probably want to know what's new innit? Let's list what's up like we always do, haha!

[h2]What's new:[/h2]

[list]
[*][h3]2 Players Online Co-op:[/h3] It's here! Access it in the main menu and invite your friend through the Steam Overlay. You'll start on Floor -1 and begin your journey to the bottom of The Gut. Each time you defeat a boss you'll unlock a checkpoint, so next time you'll want to play you can start from Floors -4/-7 etc.

 If your friend got into trouble during your co-op sessions - no worries, you can pick up your pal's brain and gently toss it into a nearby Meat Iron Maiden. It's ressurection time!

Co-op features a slightly different in-game balance as well as multiplayer exclusive mementos, for example a memento that lets you heal yourself in exchange for harming your friend! Yes, we know, we are very cruel.

Since this is just the first step for multiplayer Golden Light experience - expect some more Early Access jankiness that we'll hop on as soon as we find out about it. More than that, we are thinking about expanding on the idea of multiplayer modes and it's QoL features and other stuff that'll make it fun. For now you are able to invite or join only your steam friends, so it'd be reasonable to call each other in the discord or anywhere else. In the future though, depending on the reception of Co-op and it's performance, we'll start to think about adding quick games with randoms, lobbies, voice/text chats and maybe even customization of your Meat Bro, not even talking about crazy multiplayer ideas we have that could include more than just two players.

[*][b]Breakable walls:[/b] The walls of The Gut can now be destoyed, which will bare meaty insides. Opening a new path may reward or harm you, since newly opened will spawn enemies, weapons, items, status effects etc. I guess that's the price to pay for your curiosity!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/07972bfc3637bdf4f8feaad5ac1fc44723fa0df4.png[/img]

[*][b]New mementos:[/b] Jump in slow motion or destroy nearby walls by eating an item. Find new mementos in the game and try em out!

[*][b]New mood for the Main Menu:[/b] Holidays are here and NY 2021 is just around the corner. It's time we update our little menu with a little more christmasy vibe.

[*][b]New visuals for chains and locks:[/b] It's animated now, yay!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/020ea42f58874c09ba2ef2b6f07cb665297a69c2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/a3965d4f23d4ee88eac36e57416757ad07fc29db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/0fc66e7da5162da9c4e8997d94ec1fa124545e79.png[/img]

notes.title: The Meat Song Update is LIVE!
notes.content:
THE MEAT SONG UPDATE IS LIVE!

And to increase the excitement for this update even further we run a 20% discount for Halloween steam sale! (It will run after Halloween sale until the 8 of November too) It's the best time to grab Golden Light and experience the newest update along with all before seen content in this spookiest of times.

Check out the update trailer: 
[previewyoutube=AxopCyv94go;full][/previewyoutube]

Without further ado let's see what's new in Golden Light with The Meat Song update:

[list]
[*] [b]New Biome:[/b] The Factory is at your service! This machinery filled biome is not for the faint of heart, try to get through and meet the horrific final foe of this area, only if you can spot him. This area has settled as a second biome of the game and is the closest to the Graveyard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/25efa1601a8c39f63ae65216a615101b7b3ebffe.png[/img]

[*] [b]New monsters:[/b] The new hub as well as The Factory and other floors are now inhabited by never seen before fowl creatures. They are cunning, wicked, and sometimes quite unexpected.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/004d4fe46df6b843da912b912f5cde49fded4d9b.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New weapons:[/b] Eyetakers now possess a Meat Spear that they drop upon death, grab it, use it! You can also find a Vein Whip on cage/cabin/bar floors, whip ya enemies with it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/1f5221e1e09dab6487f37e2d4bd1df5cdb0d6494.png[/img]

[*] [b]New Hub:[/b] We've completely revisited our hub level. It's not a simple field anymore, now the hub is divided into multiple areas that you can access in whatever order you prefer. To do that, you'll need Golden Keys. Each Golden key unlocks a Golden Lock that will limit you from going further. You can find these keys in the gut (although they won't be shown on a map), as well as you can buy them from Val (The Pianist) in the Hub for 100 gold each. Since it's possible to access later floors early now - you'll may encounter a difficulty raise that you won't be able to handle, but it's not a problem since you can always start from higher floors, and because of the next thing we've added. (Beware of walking mushrooms, they'll steal yo stuff!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/6d3392ba49d5d9dcab9f9eee74be411757c7ae88.png[/img]

[*] [b]HP Upgrades:[/b] You can now increase your healthbar! Search for Golden Meats scattered across the Hub, each meat will grant you with an additional piece of healthbar and increase your max health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/dd057ef2adbab4f10f4503d28bde60f1783e7ca2.png[/img]

[*] [b]New memento:[/b] Vicious Air - you slow time when you dash. Very stylish!

[*] [b]Weather?:[/b] The hub also features a little weather mechanic that will change the lighting and overall feel of the field. It's a starting point for this idea, so we may expand on it in the future.

[*] [b]New story bits:[/b] We continue to branch out the story of the game, adding more characters, flashbacks and dialogue for you to read, let's see if you'll make sense of it though...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/766194998d7cc5ca7017e50dca520b64b72eecbd.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Notes with effects:[/b] Any note you collect has a chance to apply a random effect on you. Watch out for those jumpy words!

[*] [b]Aiming is back:[/b] Once again you can aim your ranged weapons on right mouse button.

[*] [b]Alive weapons are more alive now:[/b] Ever seen a 3 barreled revolver? If revolver is alive he be dancin with it's barrels.

[*] [b]Snout's tape recorder:[/b] You can now find tapes in the Gut, that will unlock a new soundtrack for Snout you can change while driving him around. It's a possibility that we'll add a proper select menu, but as of now - he'll play a random tune from those you've found in the Gut.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/ded580d1def30043f93e4c894beccaaef84fc6a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/f86ad27a04d87fc3aede95c8a6c01af946caf127.png[/img]

[*] [b]New and upgraded SFX:[/b] Every weapon and every single NPC that was present in Main branch now have updated sound effects. Sounds like fun!

[*] [b]Revisited Visuals and more settings:[/b] Yes, you can actually turn off the pixelation filter now, as well as some other things. We hope you'll find the right balance just for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/bd1fe135c18a5897a0f9f795380a5c1733a0ae99.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Inventory save after exiting the game:[/b] After death you'll still loose your items and weapons, but if you need to exit the game for any reason - next time you login you'll find yourself with weapons, mementos and items that you've carried in the run you've exited from.

[*] [b]Leaderboards:[/b] You can now race with other players for the best results, such as "most gold collected in 1 life", "most levels completed in 1 life", "total kills". We'll continue to polish the leaderboards to race for the best results ourselves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/21a05f4c1e5637b5334f0f2a3f7acc4088a2451a.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]UI Polishing:[/b] A bunch of UI fixes and improvements.

[*] [b]There're only 2 difficulties now:[/b] We've decided to stick with regular and permadeath options for now. The only difference between them is, obviously, permadeath. On a normal difficulty if you've finished an area - you'll go into the hub with all your gathered mementos, items and weapons and then continue to run the next area with the same set. (Unless shroomy guys will steal yo belongings)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/053a7c2f8c1f71d4aae29934382e900760fe7685.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Status Effects Synergy:[/b] From now on a combination of some status effects will create a new buff (as well as debuffs or some other interesting things in the future) for the player. Find out if you can find these combinations for yourself!

[/list]

Also, we'd like to thank Nikonekonyaa for a beatiful promo art he made for us. Check his stuff out at https://nikonekonyaa.itch.io/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/740f0f36ac44c183fe3378dad4e9f572b07dad9f.png[/img]


And this is not all, there're much more fixes, big and small, and much more to come in the future. Here's what our next steps:

[list]
[*] After this update we start to experiment with Co-op Golden Light experience due to large demand. We'll try our best, hope you'll be patient with us.
[*] The Final biome
[*] More weapons, Mementos
[*] An overall finale to Golden Light story
[/list]

notes.title: Backstreets update is on the Dev branch
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It’s been a bit more than a month since our Early Access launch and we've prepared our first big update: [b]THE BACKSTREETS[/b]. But before putting it out to public branch we'd like to run additional testing. The Backstreets is available on our dev branch, simply go to your golden light settings>Beta tab and type in [b]iwanttotestgl[/b] 

Without further do, let’s hop on a list of what’s new in Golden Light:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/d817f54be61807d5d68b46cc7b6694302e8a2cc5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]New Environment – Backstreets:[/b] These narrow downtown-esque floors have squeezed between Cages and Cabin floors. Embrace the dark corridors of asphalt and concrete and find your way out!
[*][b]2 New Bosses:[/b] Backstreets and Cabin floors are now inhabited by two new dangerous foes. It’s unknown who are they exactly, but it’s a fact they crave the light you’re carrying. Find out for yourself if you can find them back.
[*][b]New monsters:[/b] Backstreets are full of dangers, we’re not going to spoil it for you.
[*][b]New weapon – Sewer Shield:[/b] This badass piece of a live manhole cover will decrease a % of damage taken from enemies, and it also packs a punch, but, it’s very slow, so calculate your attacks wisely!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/0d1a973961dc725625c7656f53890e2c3cdb8482.png[/img]
[*][b]Story bits:[/b] We’re starting to implement the story parts. This is why between floors you won’t experience any traditional loading screens, instead, you’ll be immediately sucked into a flashback of sorts, where you may discover something new about GL story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/17206a432d1aac3122b972aebece6c6e4eaffe78.png[/img]
[*][b]MEATCH:[/b] Twitch integration: We’ve added a twitch integration to Golden Light for streamers to play with their viewers through an in-game poll. The poll results in a variety of effects that your viewers wanted you to experience the most. Some are good, some are very bad. They may heal you, repair your weapon, or spawn a gazzilion of eye takers! It’s up to them to decide.
[*][b]Healing item consumption:[/b] Now every item, no matter the effect, heals you a bit. In combination with some new mementos – this could really improve your game and make it easier for you to reach the goal.
[*][b]Glutton in the Field:[/b] You can now make the Eternal Field a home for Glutton and he’ll be able to sell you items before you descend into the Gut. We won’t tell you how, though 
[*][b]New achievements:[/b] When there’s new content, there’re also new steam achievements! Some may be a bit weird, but that’s how you like it if you dive into Golden Light, don’t you?

notes.title: Golden Light Dev Log #4: Almost there, new stuff
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been crazy few weeks since Steam Game Festival, and to everyone who checked out our demo during the festival or even wishilisted the game - thank you! We hope you enjoyed that little peek at Golden Light and we'll try not to dissapoint you and provide more weird stuff. 

[h2]Early Access[/h2]

July 10th is just a week away from us, and this means that Golden Light will go live and will be available for anyone to purchase. It's crazy to even think about it! While we're very excited - there's still a lot of work to be done, since this is just the begining for GL, and we'll be glad if you join us on this journey of seeing the game evolve and adding a little piece of yourself into this wacky game by checking our constant updates, suggesting stuff and being a part of our community.

Previously, in the last Dev Log post we've made - we stated that the game will launch at 15$ USD (with regional pricing), but since then we've reviewed the price a bit and decided to stop at an even more fair price point for Early access - 12.99$. Once again, the 15% launch discount is still intact, so if you'll decide to support us right at EA launch - it will be even more profitable for you.

If you're not from US and have questions about regional price in your country - let us know and we'll deliver the answer.

[h2]What's new?[/h2]

As always in these posts - here's what we've been working on for the past few weeks:

[list]
[*] [b]More mementos:[/b] If you prefer to use a specific weapon - we got good news for ya! Now you can find a memento that gives a damage/speed bonus to a specific weapon, be that a Pipe, an Axe, or a Blunderbuss! More than that, there're much more mementos in general, some may be really useful and other's - may come as weird at a first glance, but would work wonders combined with some other mementos in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/44537d3b8d59684ac9ca5c08d31de4d607a817d5.png[/img]
[*] [b]Wait, did you say blunderbuss?[/b] I did? I guess i did, i won't spoil too much, you'll find out on your own!
[*] [b]Time to get jazzy, welcome to the Meat Bar: [/b] From now on some floors will have a little bar area with musicians to play their jazzy tunes and a charming bartender to sell you some weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/0f9307cfa053ebe2c8e282aee1954cfe2e7da65d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/637853d034c54c39ec3806718bcd9be7774412c0.png[/img]
[*] [b]Gamepad support:[/b] Yes, not much to say about that. If you prefer to play games with your gamepad - now you'll be able to play Golden Light this way as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/dacb2623259101df9b661910cd646723e107c7d7.png[/img]
[*] [b]UI rework:[/b] We've re-designed our UI a bit to make it more unique and stylish. Hope you'll enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/864f043f00eaa9013000824d0e0180490e6b9b36.png[/img]
[*] [b]Even more monsters:[/b] A screetching sentient blade will be waiting for you in the Gut.
[*] [b]Key rebinding:[/b] Speaks for itself. There're some buttons that you can't rebind, like movement on WASD, but other than that - make it more suitable for you! (For now it only works for keyboard - but we'll add controller rebinding in the future)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/b9888a991166724ff8173c5df7838110da2b77ef.png[/img]
[*] [b]New status effect - Love:[/b] Don't you want somebody to love? Don't you need somebody to love? This new status effect will allow you to love and show your love to the inhabitants of the Gut, let's see how they react.
[*] [b]Meat traps:[/b] A meat trap that you can disarm, otherwise stepping on it would spread a negative status effect across the room. Look under your feet! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/b3b5da1b59f3eae92475e86b82e7dd01c4bd4120.png[/img]
[*] [b]Spanish and German languages:[/b] Thanks to our community we've implemented Spanish and German translation into the game. It's not perfect for now, but we'll be continiously working on fixing any issues, making it more right for native speakers of those languages and also adding more languages in general!
[*] [b]Quests: [/b] Some NPCs will have a task for ya, do them a favor and they'll be at your service.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/a605bf7a96408bbbd4c560c2c457d6e3d5781127.png[/img]
[*] [b]Cults:[/b] These living meat freaks are starting cults! Whether they prefer to breathe poison, constantly burn or suck your precious blood - talk to them and see what they can offer you, maybe even join a cult!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/886d23d255865874828af154c3022045c0de6231.png[/img]
[*] [b]And even more![/b] So much it's hard to list everything.
[/list]

That's it for this update post, we'll see you in a week!

notes.title: Golden Light Dev Log #3: Road to Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone and "Welcome to the meat zone".

"I write this with two fingers that i have left". Because the rest of our fingers are working very hard on Golden Light, haha!

It's been some time since last update post and we don't want to leave you uninformed on all things Golden Light, so, let's see what we were working on!

[h2]Steam Game Festival[/h2]

SGF starts next week, so everyone who didn't check out our public demo builds will be able to do exactly that from June 9th to June 14th. Also, we want to remind you that we'll hold a developer stream on June 9th at 19:00 UTC, be sure to hop onto our livestream on the Golden Light steam page to ask questions, chat with us and listen what will be available in Golden Light at Early Access launch in the first half of July 2020.

[h2]Early Access[/h2]

We've decided to take more time to polish what's already in the game and also add new content. There were problems and issues that we needed to adress with GL, that's why we've moved EA launch to aforementioned July, although the store page may still mention June. Please understand c; 

In exchange i can finally announce that the [u][b]game will be priced at 15$ for the span of Early Access[/b][/u] (regional prices may differ), with price being increased at full release.

[h2]Discord[/h2]

We've made a discord channel that you can join and discuss the game with us, make suggestions that will be noticed much faster than those made on steam discussion board and let us know about bugs and stuff. So if you're interested in seeing Golden Light evolve - we welcome you: https://discord.gg/Y8sNMFs


[h2]Localization[/h2]

Currently the game is developed in English and Russian languages, and since there're lots of things that will be added and also an abscence of budgeting we can't straight up go to loc studios and use their service to help us with localization. This is why we decided to handle translation of GL with the help of our community! If you'd like to help us translate Golden Light into your native language - feel free to join our discord mentioned above and let us know! Every single contributor of localization process will be rightfully credited in Golden Light for their help.



[h2]What's new?[/h2]

And now let's discuss our favorite part of these update posts! What's new in Golden Light?

[list]
[*][b]New enviroment:[/b] We've added a new set of frozen/forest tiles. Be aware, this location hides more danger that you can imagine, don't be fooled by "cool" snowy corridors and warm cabins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/b5ff416f5eb5ebc96e4b392a8b3cd6da51772a53.png[/img]
[*][b]New enviroment:[/b] We've also added a new enviroment for Castle floor. No matter how fast you run, he'll find you, and he'll try to stop you from descending further into the Gut.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/8a676edbc5e1327ce3cc23b2c437ba72a9ba7b6b.png[/img]
[*][b]New monsters:[/b] There are bunch of new cheeky sneaky creatures that will try to stand against your journey into the depths, be careful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/b90e573d0272f2673cda76cb5e3a0863f2f7d130.png[/img]
[*][b]Sentient weapons and effects:[/b] Every weapon in the game is unique now. It has a name, it has status effects, it's own little story. And some weapons may also require you to spend some gold in exchange for their help. Choose your "friends" wisely!
[*][b]Optimization:[/b] Golden Light's performance was greatly improved! Well, not much to say about that.

[/list]

[h2]Known issues:[/h2]

[list]
[*]After we've moved to new render pipeline and some updates, you may experience some gamebreaking crashes. For some reason they occur not for everyone, which makes it a bit more difficult to find what causes it. We're working hard to resolve this issue. 
[*]Level generator is a bit freaky from time to time, which shouldn't ruin your experience. Still, this will be adressed in future updates.
[/list]

That's all for this update post, we're looking forward to see you on our livestream and also to see more feedback on the game when public steam demo comes out on June 9th.

Stay safe and have a great day!

notes.title: Golden Light Dev log #1: What's in store, Early Access
notes.content:
Hello guys,

We are working hard on the game and today we'd like to talk about our progress and plans so far:

[list]
[*]Public Demo
[*]Updates
[*] What we are working on right now
[*]Early Access
[/list]

[u][b]Public Demo[/b][/u]

Currently if you want to play an early build of Golden Light you can grab it at two places:
Our gamejolt page: [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/goldenLight/474999]Here[/url]
and on Itchio: [url=https://daneelgames.itch.io/golden-light-demo]Here[/url]

It is absolutely free and this way you can track our progress on the game so far, as we're constantly updating those builds on both platforms. These builds are fully playable, and we would really love to hear from you guys about what you think on the current state of the game.

[u][b]Updates[/b][/u]

As i've stated before, we are constantly updating the game and about 3 weeks passed since we initially uploaded a build to one of aforementioned platforms. Here i'd like to list a number of important features that made it into the game after the initial build release and that will play a major role in our game later on:

[list]
[*][b]Mementos:[/b] Mementos are basically skills for your character that you can find on each floor of your journey, and that as well can be bought from various NPCs you'll encounter on your way. Each memento grants you different abbilities. Here's some of them: Permament increase of your max Health/speed, permament decrease of your stamina usage for sprint/dash. Some of them will let you damage enemies when you dash and some will turn you crazy, adding elements of hallucinations into your playthrough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/94cdfd2a53dee78f59f69a35e971397a820c5576.png[/img]
[*][b]Positive/Negative effects:[/b] Some rooms or encounters can poison you, and some might help you out by regenerating your health back. We're working hard on making more of these effects and adding it to the game to increase replaybillity and make each run unique.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/4df3811fad4b484676649bc20fd486dd3504b0b0.png[/img]
[*][b]Hub:[/b] After each death you'll now be transported to the hub. This is a calm field with different things to encounter, such as NPCs, items to help you in your next run and other interesting features. Further in game's development the Hub will evolve while you make progress in the game, adding more NPCs and encounters depending on how far did you get on your elevator.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/11346296caa3efacbab9099de8f4f4c7fc967168.png[/img]
[*][b]Portable map:[/b] A lot of players had difficulties with navigation in our tight, sometimes maze-like enviroment, so we've made a portable map that you can take with you and never get lost again! (But be careful, it bites).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36862231/d1d04a9e6a92397d833fe0378d6dd7c48d585811.png[/img]
[/list]
Of course there're much more thing we've fixed and added, but we'll inform you about those things in our regular patch notes that we'll be posting once per few days.

[u][b]What we are working on right now[/b][/u]

Currently there is much more stuff that we would like to implement and test out in preparation to our Early Access launch. First and foremost - The first boss fight of Golden Light. We're almost done with 3D art for this very encounter and soon we'll have more things to share.

Also, there's a "tools" mechanic now. Currently player can find a usable item with unknown effects. It is up to you how you would like to test those effects, whether by consuming the item, or by throwing it at your foes. As soon as we're ready to show it - we'll add it to early builds on aforementioned platforms.

We're also hard at work on new enviroments, as hellish office spaces may get boring after a few runs, so we're cooking up something new to add to the visuals as players progress through their journey.

[u][b]Early Access[/b][/u]

As soon as we feel we're ready to take our little game into an open sea of Early Access - we'll do exactly that. The current situation in the world due to Covid-19 leaves it's marks and some of developers on our team has lost their jobs and need to somehow support themselves. We're very determined to finish this game and would also like to do this with the help of our community that may be interested in seeing Golden Light bloom and shine at it's finest. There's no particular date that is set in stone, but we will update you on the matter as soon as "Mr.Pink is ready".
